page_title: JUV 2-2 LAZ | Juventus v Lazio 08/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.

90+6' 2 - 2 Jeremie Boga showcases his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) meets the cross and gets himself onto the scoresheet with a header inside the right post. It's 2:2.
90+4' Juventus take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+2' Juventus have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

90+1' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) takes the ball, nicely zig-zags through the defence, but his shot to the left post is smartly dealt with by Ivan Provedel. Juventus force their opponents to concede a corner.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.

89' Edon Zhegrova (Juventus) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and has an effort on goal. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies inches high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
87' Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) takes a short pass in his stride inside the box, but hits a poor shot at goal that goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
84' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Weston McKennie walks off the pitch to be replaced by Lois Openda (Juventus).
83' Substitution. Manuel Locatelli walks off the pitch and Fabio Miretti (Juventus) comes on as a substitute.
83' Problems for Maurizio Sarri as Oliver Provstgaard (Lazio) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Patric replaces him.
83' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Weston McKennie (Juventus) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
82' The free kick from long range, taken by Juventus, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
81' Marco Guida shows a yellow card to Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) for his blatant foul.
79' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) fires a volley towards the left side of the goal from the edge of the penalty box, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save.
78' Lazio are ruled offside.
77' Luciano Spalletti decides to make a substitution. Teun Koopmeiners will be replaced by Lloyd Kelly (Juventus).
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) will replace Mario Gila.
76' We are about to witness a subsitution. Jeremie Boga (Juventus) for Andrea Cambiaso.
76' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Juventus comes to nothing.

76' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) runs onto a good ball played into the box and hits a first-time screamer towards goal, but a defender somehow gets his body in the way and makes the block. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Juventus.
72' Referee Marco Guida sees the trip by Weston McKennie (Juventus) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Lazio have a free kick.
70' Edon Zhegrova (Juventus) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.

67' Kenneth Taylor (Lazio) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
64' Pedro goes off the pitch and Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) comes on.

64' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) took a first-time shot from mid-range after he was put in the clear by a great pass, but the effort lacked a little accuracy and went just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
64' Maurizio Sarri prepares a substitution. Gustav Isaksen is replaced by Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio).
63' A crossfield pass from Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
62' Edon Zhegrova (Juventus) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
62' Juventus can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

59' 1 - 2 It's a goal! Weston McKennie (Juventus) alters the score to 1:2. He latched on to a good cross into the box from Andrea Cambiaso, steering his header from close range off the left post into the back of the net. Ivan Provedel was helpless.

59' A sweet pass finds Edon Zhegrova (Juventus) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the bottom left corner. Ivan Provedel is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
52' The resulting set piece from Juventus is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
51' Edon Zhegrova (Juventus) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
47' 0 - 2 Danilo Cataldi plays a neat ball into the path of Gustav Isaksen (Lazio), who makes room for a shot and fires in off the crossbar! 0:2.
46' Here is a change. Juan Cabal is going off and Luciano Spalletti gives the last tactical orders to Edon Zhegrova (Juventus).
46' Maurizio Sarri has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Fisayo Dele-Bashiru comes on the pitch for Toma Basic (Lazio).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

45+2' 0 - 1 Goal! Daniel Maldini plays in Pedro (Lazio), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders and from inside the box he shoots into the left side of the net! Great finish - 0:1.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
42' Toma Basic (Lazio) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

33' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Ivan Provedel scrambling, but it flies just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
33' Marco Guida shows the yellow card to Kenneth Taylor (Lazio) for a heavy challenge.
28' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Juventus due to an offside in the build-up play.
26' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and drills a shot into the bottom left corner in trademark fashion.
24' Toma Basic (Lazio) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
22' Neat passing move from Lazio in order to create new attacking opportunities.
20' Juventus fail to score from a corner as Ivan Provedel (Lazio) leaps to collect the ball.
19' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Juventus.
17' Juventus failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
17' Ivan Provedel makes a difficult save to deny Bremer (Juventus), who attempted to score with a header from inside the box. Juventus have been awarded a corner kick.

16' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. Juventus will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
15' A neat pass is well received by Kenan Yildiz (Juventus), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball on goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
14' Great touch by Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save!
13' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Juventus.
12' The linesman raises his flag. Jonathan David (Juventus) is adjudged offside.
9' Daniel Maldini (Lazio) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Marco Guida has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Juventus have been awarded a free kick.
3' Juventus seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
1' The first half has started.
Juventus will kick-off.
Marco Guida was nominated as the referee for this game.
